I saved Hollis's note (Gate 40 is now their dock for Marrow Agrisupply pickups) and confirmed it in their DM.

The first save came back marked visible to everyone in the shared memory. The note came from a private DM, so I saved it again as private and withdrew the shared copy. Withdrawing it only takes it out of active memory: the brain keeps an audit record of the old entry. As far as I can tell, the private copy is the only active one now.
